scenes.title: Full-stack platform
scenes.body: One Node repo hosts Encompass tooling, AI assistants, unified disasters, music research, and Lane genealogy.

scenes.title: Node · Postgres · CI
scenes.body: Express routes call services — not fat controllers. PostgreSQL holds graphs, disasters, config, and chat memory. Jest keeps CI green.

scenes.title: LangChain · Vision · RAG
scenes.body: OpenAI powers Encompass Assistant, loan pipeline AI, and Screen Test. ICE knowledge RAG grounds answers. HeyGen avatars and HyperFrames explain the product.

scenes.title: Hub · calcs · ops
scenes.body: Encompass Hub APIs, shared calculationEngine math, processor assignment scoring, and Unit Tests with Automator manifest review.

scenes.title: Bootstrap · vanilla JS
scenes.body: No React — AG Grid and DataTables where grids matter. Design tokens, dark mode, and a sitewide voice widget.

scenes.title: Hazard · geo · music
scenes.body: FEMA, NASA FIRMS, NOAA, and USGS feed unified disasters. Google Maps geocodes family and hazard layers. MusicBrainz and Wikimedia power music research.

scenes.title: Stack page · video hub
scenes.body: Browse grouped stack cards on stack.html — or every HeyGen clip and HyperFrames reel on the public video hub.
